name: PETRICHOR
source:
BE NOT AFRAID.

lost in a storm and hunted by hallowed forces,  deliver lily from a fairytale that should not have been told.

[From [url=https://elzibeht.itch.io/petrichor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不要害怕。

在暴风雨中迷路并被神圣力量追捕，将莉莉从不应该讲述的童话中解救出来。

[来自[url=https://elzibeht.itch.io/petrichor]itch.io[/url]]
